label: Checkout branch
args: echo "[checkout-branch] $ZED_GIT_REF" > /tmp/zed-git.log; if git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" checkout "$ZED_GIT_REF" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; if ! grep -q 'would be overwritten by checkout' /tmp/zed-git.log; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Checkout failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; CHOICE=$(osascript -e 'button returned of (display dialog "Local changes block the switch to $ZED_GIT_REF. Choose how to proceed:" buttons {"Cancel", "Stash & Switch", "Stash, Switch, Pop"} default button "Cancel")' 2>> /tmp/zed-git.log) || exit 0; STASHOUT=$(git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" stash push -u -m "zed: before checkout $ZED_GIT_REF" 2>&1); echo "$STASHOUT" >> /tmp/zed-git.log; if echo "$STASHOUT" | grep -q 'No local changes to save'; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Nothing to stash, but the switch is still blocked (see /tmp/zed-git.log). Resolve manually." buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$STASHOUT" | grep -qvi 'saved working directory'; then if ! echo "$STASHOUT" | grep -qi 'saved working directory'; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Stash failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; fi; if ! git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" checkout "$ZED_GIT_REF" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Stashed, but switch still failed. Still on old branch; your work is safe in the stash (git stash list). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; if [ "$CHOICE" = "Stash, Switch, Pop" ]; then if git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" stash pop >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Switched to $ZED_GIT_REF and reapplied your changes." buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; else osascript -e 'display dialog "Switched to $ZED_GIT_REF, but reapplying changes hit conflicts. Your stash was kept (git stash list). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; fi; else osascript -e 'display dialog "Switched to $ZED_GIT_REF. Your changes are saved in the stash; run git stash pop to restore them." buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; fi

label: Push branch
args: echo "[push] $ZED_GIT_REF" > /tmp/zed-git.log; osascript -e 'display dialog "Push $ZED_GIT_REF to origin?" buttons {"Cancel", "Push"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" push -u origin "$ZED_GIT_REF" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Push failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'

label: Delete branch
args: echo "[delete-branch] $ZED_GIT_REF" > /tmp/zed-git.log; osascript -e 'display dialog "Delete local branch $ZED_GIT_REF?" buttons {"Cancel", "Delete"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; if git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" branch -d "$ZED_GIT_REF" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; if grep -q 'not fully merged' /tmp/zed-git.log; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Branch $ZED_GIT_REF is NOT fully merged. Force delete and lose unmerged commits?" buttons {"Cancel", "Force Delete"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" branch -D "$ZED_GIT_REF" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Force delete failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; else osascript -e 'display dialog "Delete failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; fi

label: Delete remote branch
args: echo "[delete-remote] $ZED_GIT_REF" > /tmp/zed-git.log; osascript -e 'display dialog "Delete REMOTE branch $ZED_GIT_REF on origin? This affects the remote." buttons {"Cancel", "Delete"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" push origin --delete "$(echo "$ZED_GIT_REF" | sed 's,^origin/,,')" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Remote delete failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'

label: Checkout commit (detached)
args: echo "[checkout-commit] $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT" > /tmp/zed-git.log; git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" checkout "$ZED_GIT_SHA" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Checkout failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'

label: Create branch here
args: echo "[create-branch] from $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT" > /tmp/zed-git.log; branch=$(osascript -e 'text returned of (display dialog "New branch name (from $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT):" default answer "")' 2>> /tmp/zed-git.log) || exit 0; if [ -z "$branch" ]; then exit 0; fi; git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" checkout -b "$branch" "$ZED_GIT_SHA" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Create branch failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'

label: Reset (hard)
args: echo "[reset-hard] $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT" > /tmp/zed-git.log; osascript -e 'display dialog "Reset --hard to $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT? This discards uncommitted changes." buttons {"Cancel", "Reset"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" reset --hard "$ZED_GIT_SHA" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Reset failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'

label: Merge into current branch
args: echo "[merge] $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT" > /tmp/zed-git.log; osascript -e 'display dialog "Merge $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT into current branch?" buttons {"Cancel", "Merge"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; OUT=$(git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" merge "$ZED_GIT_SHA" 2>&1); RC=$?; echo "$OUT" >> /tmp/zed-git.log; if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! echo "$OUT" | grep -qi 'stash'; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Merge failed (conflicts?). Resolve in the terminal. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; osascript -e 'display dialog "Merge is blocked by uncommitted local changes. Stash them, merge, then restore?" buttons {"Cancel", "Stash & Merge"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; SOUT=$(git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" stash push -u -m "zed: before merge $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT" 2>&1); echo "$SOUT" >> /tmp/zed-git.log; if echo "$SOUT" | grep -q 'No local changes to save'; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Nothing to stash, but still blocked. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; if ! echo "$SOUT" | grep -qi 'saved working directory'; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Stash failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; if ! git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" merge "$ZED_GIT_SHA" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Stashed, but merge hit conflicts. Resolve in terminal; your WIP is in the stash (git stash list). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; if git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" stash pop >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Merged and restored your changes." buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; else osascript -e 'display dialog "Merged, but restoring your changes hit conflicts. Stash kept (git stash list). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; fi

label: Rebase on
args: echo "[rebase] $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT" > /tmp/zed-git.log; osascript -e 'display dialog "Rebase current branch onto $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT?" buttons {"Cancel", "Rebase"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; OUT=$(git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" rebase "$ZED_GIT_SHA" 2>&1); RC=$?; echo "$OUT" >> /tmp/zed-git.log; if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! echo "$OUT" | grep -qi 'stash'; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Rebase failed (conflicts?). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; if ! git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" rebase "$ZED_GIT_SHA" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Stashed, but rebase hit conflicts. Resolve in terminal; your WIP is in the stash (git stash list). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; exit 0; fi; if git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" stash pop >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Rebased and restored your changes." buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; else osascript -e 'display dialog "Rebased, but restoring your changes hit conflicts. Stash kept (git stash list). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'; fi

label: Revert

(creates a new commit that undoes it)" buttons {"Cancel", "Revert"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; OUT=$(git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" revert --no-edit "$ZED_GIT_SHA" 2>&1); RC=$?; echo "$OUT" >> /tmp/zed-git.log; if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! echo "$OUT" | grep -qi 'stash'; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Revert failed (conflicts?). Resolve in the terminal. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; exit 0; fi; osascript -e 'display dialog "Revert is blocked by uncommitted local changes. Stash them, revert, then restore?" buttons {"Cancel", "Stash & Revert"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; SOUT=$(git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" stash push -u -m "zed: before revert $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT" 2>&1); echo "$SOUT" >> /tmp/zed-git.log; if echo "$SOUT" | grep -q 'No local changes to save'; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Nothing to stash, but still blocked. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; exit 0; fi; if ! echo "$SOUT" | grep -qi 'saved working directory'; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Stash failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; exit 0; fi; if ! git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" revert --no-edit "$ZED_GIT_SHA" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Stashed, but revert hit conflicts. Resolve in terminal; your WIP is in the stash (git stash list). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; exit 0; fi; if git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" stash pop >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Reverted and restored your changes." buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; else osascript -e 'display dialog "Reverted, but restoring your changes hit conflicts. Stash kept (git stash list). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; fi

label: Create tag
args: echo "[tag-create] at $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT" > /tmp/zed-git.log; tag=$(osascript -e 'text returned of (display dialog "New tag name (at $ZED_GIT_SHA_SHORT):" default answer "")' 2>> /tmp/zed-git.log) || exit 0; if [ -z "$tag" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" tag "$tag" "$ZED_GIT_SHA" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Tag create failed (already exists?). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; exit 0; fi; PUSH=$(osascript -e 'button returned of (display dialog "Tag created. Push it to origin now?" buttons {"No", "Push"} default button "No")' 2>> /tmp/zed-git.log) || exit 0; if [ "$PUSH" = "Push" ]; then git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" push origin "$tag" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Tag push failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; fi

label: Delete tag
args: echo "[tag-delete]" > /tmp/zed-git.log; tag=$(osascript -e 'text returned of (display dialog "Tag name to delete:" default answer "")' 2>> /tmp/zed-git.log) || exit 0; if [ -z "$tag" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" tag -d "$tag" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1; then osascript -e 'display dialog "Tag delete failed (no such tag?). See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; exit 0; fi; DEL=$(osascript -e 'button returned of (display dialog "Local tag deleted. Also delete it on origin?" buttons {"No", "Delete on origin"} default button "No")' 2>> /tmp/zed-git.log) || exit 0; if [ "$DEL" = "Delete on origin" ]; then git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" push origin --delete "$tag" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Remote tag delete failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"' ; fi

label: Push tag
args: echo "[tag-push]" > /tmp/zed-git.log; tag=$(osascript -e 'text returned of (display dialog "Tag name to push to origin:" default answer "")' 2>> /tmp/zed-git.log) || exit 0; if [ -z "$tag" ]; then exit 0; fi; git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" push origin "$tag" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Tag push failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'

See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'

Moves HEAD; changes kept in working tree (unstaged)." buttons {"Cancel", "Reset"} default button "Cancel"' >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || exit 0; git -C "$ZED_GIT_REPOSITORY_PATH" reset --mixed "$ZED_GIT_SHA" >> /tmp/zed-git.log 2>&1 || osascript -e 'display dialog "Reset failed. See /tmp/zed-git.log" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'
